capabilities: Render a yearly heatmap from completed routine tasks
Detect routines via a leading {id} token on tasks
Optionally color calendar days by completion
Filter tasks by daily note folder, frontmatter or inline tag
Configure week start day, weekday language, and today highlight
extras: Distributed via GitHub releases with manual copy into the plugins folder; no built-in routine list—any {id} appearing in daily notes is counted.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to visualize day-by-day completion of recurring routine tasks recorded in daily notes.
summary: Yearly heatmap plugin that paints cells from completed id-tagged routine tasks found in your daily notes.
